notes.title: GamePlay Update
notes.notes:
A new leveling system has been implemented for ALL Arenas. This new progressive leveling system brings a new balance to the game with a steady difficulty. Please leave your thoughts here or on discord!
Your feedback is appreciated!

notes.title: Release date March 13th!
notes.notes: March 13th will mark the date of RavenAboutGames' first ever game release.  This early access release will be a well-rounded version of Senshi Tank 2 with the majority of development completed by this time.  However, additional content is still in the works.
